| norm : E -> ExUpperReal
| norm_zro : norm zro = 0
| norm_negative {x : E} : norm (negative x) = norm x
| norm_+ {x y : E} : norm (x + y) <= norm x ExUpperReal.+ norm y
| norm-dist {x y : E} : dist x y = norm (x - y)
\func IsUnbounded : \Prop
\lemma norm_*n_<=_*n {n : Nat} {a : E} : norm (n *n a) <= n ExUpperRealAbMonoid.*n norm a
\lemma norm_*n_<= {n : Nat} {a : E} : norm (n *n a) <= n ExUpperReal.* norm a
\lemma norm_BigSum {l : Array E} : norm (BigSum l) <= ExUpperRealAbMonoid.BigSum (\lam j => norm (l j))
\lemma norm_FinSum {A : FinSet} {f : A -> E} : norm (FinSum f) <= ExUpperRealAbMonoid.FinSum (\lam j => norm (f j))
\lemma norm>=0 {X : ExPseudoNormedAbGroup} {x : X} : 0 <= norm x
\lemma norm_dist {X : ExPseudoNormedAbGroup} {x : X} : norm x = dist 0 x
\lemma norm_- {X : ExPseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : norm (x - y) = norm (y - x)
\lemma norm_dist-left {X : ExPseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : norm x <= dist x y + norm y
\lemma norm_dist-right {X : ExPseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : norm x <= norm y + dist x y

\class ExNormedAbGroup \extends ExPseudoNormedAbGroup, ExMetricSpace { | norm-ext {x : E} : norm x = ExUpperRealAbMonoid.zro -> x = 0 | dist-ext => \lam p => fromZero $ norm-ext $ inv norm-dist *> p | norm-ext => \lam p => dist-ext $ norm-dist *> pmap norm (pmap (_ +) negative_zro *> zro-right) *> p }
\class BoundedExPseudoNormedAbGroup \extends ExPseudoNormedAbGroup { | norm-bounded (x : E) : (norm x).IsBounded }
\lemma distBounded : IsDistBounded
\func bnorm {X : BoundedExPseudoNormedAbGroup} (x : X) : UpperReal
\class PseudoNormedAbGroup \extends BoundedExPseudoNormedAbGroup, PseudoMetricSpace { \override norm : E -> Real | dist => dist | norm-dist => norm-dist-impl | norm-bounded => \lam x => U-inh }
\class NormedAbGroup \extends PseudoNormedAbGroup, ExNormedAbGroup
\func lnorm {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} (x : X) : Real
\lemma lnorm>=0 {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} {x : X} : 0 <= X.norm x
\lemma lnorm_zro {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} : lnorm X.zro = RealAbGroup.zro
\lemma lnorm_+ {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : lnorm (x + y) <= lnorm x + lnorm y
\lemma lnorm-ldist {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : ldist x y = lnorm (x - y)
\lemma lnorm_BigSum {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} {l : Array X} : lnorm (X.BigSum l) <= RealAbGroup.BigSum (\lam j => lnorm (l j))
\lemma lnorm_- {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : lnorm (x - y) = lnorm (y - x)
\lemma lnorm_-left {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : lnorm x - lnorm y <= lnorm (x - y)
\lemma lnorm_-right {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : lnorm y - lnorm x <= lnorm (x - y)
\lemma lnorm_-_abs {X : PseudoNormedAbGroup} {x y : X} : RealAbGroup.abs (lnorm x - lnorm y) <= lnorm (x - y)

\record UniformNormedAbGroupMap \extends UniformMetricMap, TopAbGroupMap { \override Dom : ExPseudoNormedAbGroup \override Cod : ExPseudoNormedAbGroup | func-norm-uniform : ∀ {eps : Rat} (0 < eps) ∃ (delta : Rat) (0 < delta) ∀ {x : Dom} ((norm x).U delta -> (norm (func x)).U eps) | func-dist-uniform => \lam eps>0 => (\case func-norm-uniform eps>0 \with { | inP (delta, delta>0, h) => inP (delta, delta>0, unfold (\lam d => rewrite (norm-dist {Cod}, inv AddGroupHom.func-minus) $ h $ rewriteI (norm-dist {Dom}) d)) }) | func-norm-uniform => \lam eps>0 => (\case dist_open.1 (func-cont OBall-open) $ rewrite func-zro $ OBall-center eps>0 \with { | inP (delta, delta>0, h) => inP (delta, delta>0, \lam d => rewrite (norm_dist {Cod}, inv func-zro) $ h $ rewrite (norm_dist {Dom}) in d) }) }
